infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wishfit listens so you can dictate instead of typing. Recognition happens on your phone; only the text is sent, never the audio.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Wishfit listens so you can dictate instead of typing. Recognition happens on your phone; only the text is sent, never the audio.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wishfit uses the camera so you can snap a product as a gift idea. The photo is sent to the agent to recognise the product.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wishfit reads the photo you choose so the agent can recognise the product in it.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Wishfit does not track your movement; this is required by a system library the app includes.

web.name: Wishfit
web.description: Gift ideas that fit the person, from an agent that asks first.
